8-s108.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 8, с. 108. Составь предложения с believe и understand.
steps: I don't believe you. He believes the story. We don't understand the text. She understands the story.
8-s108.answer: believe / don't believe; understand / don't understand

9-s108.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 9, с. 108. Прослушай и спой песенку «There's a room in my house».
steps: Смысл: в моём доме есть комната, в комнате — кровать, у кровати — лампа, у лампы — шкаф… Слушаем и поём.
9-s108.answer: Поём песню о комнате в доме.

10-s109.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 10, с. 109. Прочитай текст и скажи, что произошло с Анной Крук.
steps: Anna Crook saw a burglar in her neighbour's house and called the police.
10-s109.answer: She saw a burglar in the neighbour's house.

11-s110.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 11, с. 110. Расставь предложения в правильном порядке и перескажи текст.
steps: 2, 4, 5, 1, 3, 6, 7. Пересказ: Anna Crook lived opposite the Browns. One evening she saw a light in their house, but the Browns were away. She believed it was a burglar and called the police. The police came and found… the Browns' cat and a lamp that had switched on!

12-s110.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 12, с. 110. Опиши дом или квартиру друга или родственника.
steps: My friend John lives in a big flat with five rooms: his parents' bedroom, a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and his room. His room is big: a desk next to the door, an armchair in front of the sofa, a carpet on the floor and a lamp next to the bed.
12-s110.answer: My friend lives in a flat. There are … rooms. In his room there is …

13-s110.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 13, с. 110. Составь диалог о месте, где ты живёшь.
steps: A: Do you live in a house or a flat? B: In a flat. And you? A: In a house. How many rooms are there in your flat? B: Five: my parents' bedroom, a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and my room. A: What is there in your room? B: A desk next to the door, an armchair, a carpet and a lamp next to the bed.
13-s110.answer: house or flat? how many rooms? what is there in your room?

14-s110.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 14, с. 110. Заполни пропуски предлогами.
steps: 1. at; 2. in, in; 3. on; 4. on; 5. at; 6. in, in.
14-s110.answer: at 24 Primrose Street; in a block of flats in London; on the first floor; on the second floor; at 17 High Street; in America in 2000

15-s111.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 15, с. 111. Прочитай текст и напиши о квартире (своей или друга).
steps: I live in a flat. There are three rooms: my parents' bedroom, a living room and my room, a kitchen and a bathroom. My room is light: there is a bed by the window, a desk next to the door, a bookcase and a carpet in the middle.
15-s111.answer: I live in a flat. There are … rooms. My room is …

16-s111.condition: Lesson 22, упр. 16, с. 111. Потренируйся писать новые слова.
steps: happen (to) — случаться; study — кабинет; suddenly — вдруг; cupboard — шкаф; believe — верить; fridge — холодильник; understand (understood) — понимать.
16-s111.answer: happen, study, suddenly, cupboard, believe, fridge, understand

1-s111.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 1, с. 111. По картинкам «расставь» мебель по комнатам.
steps: There is a cooker, a fridge, a table and chairs in the kitchen. There is a sink and a mirror in the bathroom. There is a telephone and pictures in the hall. There is a sofa, a fireplace, a TV, armchairs and a lamp in the living room. There is a bed, a wardrobe and a standard lamp in the bedroom.
1-s111.answer: kitchen — cooker, fridge; bathroom — sink, mirror; hall — telephone; living room — sofa, TV; bedroom — bed, wardrobe

2-s112.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 2, с. 112. Опиши любую комнату, используя данные фразы.
steps: On the left as you come into my bedroom there is a bookcase with my favourite books. Next to the bookcase there is an armchair — I like reading there. In the corner there is a small wardrobe. In front of the window there is a desk with a computer. My bed is on the right.
2-s112.answer: On the left…, next to…, in the corner…, in front of the window…, on the right…

3-s112.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 3, с. 112. Скажи, что делают Смиты в комнатах и какая там мебель.
steps: There is a desk and a bookcase in the study — Mr Smith works and reads there. There are two beds in the small bedroom — the children sleep there. There is a bath and a sink in the bathroom — they wash and take a shower. There is a cooker and a fridge in the kitchen — Mrs Smith cooks. There is a sofa and a TV in the living room — the family watch TV.
3-s112.answer: study — works; bedroom — sleep; bathroom — wash; kitchen — cook; living room — watch TV

4-s112.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 4, с. 112. Составь предложения с данными словами; одноклассники соглашаются или нет.
steps: This textbook is rather difficult. The exercises are very easy. Houses in the city centre are terribly expensive. Pushkin is famous for his poems. Sport is very important. — I agree / I don't agree.
4-s112.answer: rather, very, terribly, famous for, important — I agree / I don't agree

5-s113.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 5, с. 113. Опиши дом или квартиру, в которой ты бы хотел жить.
steps: I would like to live in a small house in the country. It would be clean and comfortable: a small kitchen, a bathroom and two rooms. My favourite room would be a lovely living room with a fireplace, where I would read in the evening. There would be many trees and flowers near the house.
5-s113.answer: I would like to live in … There would be …

6-s113.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 6, с. 113. a) Задай Питу вопросы о грабителе; b) от лица Пита расскажи историю.
steps: a) When did you see the burglar? Where did you see him? What was he doing? Did you call the police?
b) It happened last Friday. I was walking along the street. Suddenly I saw a burglar near the cafe. He pushed an old woman, took her bag and ran away. I called the police and helped the woman.
6-s113.answer: a) when, where, what, did you call…; b) It happened … Suddenly I saw … I called the police.

7-s113.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 7, с. 113. Выбери слова по темам «Место проживания» и «Мебель» и прочитай их быстро.
steps: bathroom, bedroom, bookcase, cupboard, curtains, door, downstairs, flat, garden, hall, house, kitchen, living room, mirror, study, sink, standard lamp, sofa, armchair, wardrobe, fridge, cooker.
7-s113.answer: rooms: bathroom, bedroom, hall, kitchen, living room, study; furniture: bookcase, cupboard, sofa, armchair, wardrobe, lamp, mirror

8-s113.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 8, с. 113. Прочитай вторую часть текста и скажи, кто грабитель.
steps: Семья вернулась с прогулки и увидела открытую дверь, открытый холодильник и разбросанную еду. Они позвали полицию. Грабителем оказался маленький енот (a raccoon), который залез в дом через трубу.

9-s114.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 9, с. 114. Расскажи, как, по-твоему, закончился рассказ.
steps: Suddenly the Jacksons saw something small on the chimney. It wasn't a real burglar — it was a small raccoon. Everybody was surprised except the policeman.
9-s114.answer: The burglar was a raccoon on the chimney.

10-s114.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 10, с. 114. Прочитай оригинальную концовку и скажи, отличается ли она от твоей.
steps: The real ending and my ending are almost the same: the burglar was a raccoon. / My ending is different — I thought it was a cat.

11-s114.condition: Lesson 23, упр. 11, с. 114. Представь свою новую квартиру и опиши её.
steps: Our new flat is very comfortable. There are three rooms: my parents' bedroom, my room and a living room, a kitchen, a hall and a bathroom. In the living room there is a sofa, a TV and a lamp. We read, watch TV and talk there. My room is light and quiet.
11-s114.answer: Our new flat: … rooms; living room — sofa, TV; my room — light and quiet

project-work-2-s114.condition: Lesson 23, с. 114. Проект: глава 2 книги «Смотри, что мы умеем по-английски» — «Место, где мы живём».
steps: The Place We Live In: описания наших домов и квартир, план комнаты с подписями мебели, рисунки, стихи и песни о доме, пословица «There is no place like home».
project-work-2-s114.answer: Глава о доме: описания, планы комнат, рисунки.

1-s115.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 1, с. 115. Прослушай и повтори новые слова.
steps: town — городок: there are many small towns in the south of England; city — большой город: the city of London; square — площадь: in Red Square; main — главный: the main street; road — дорога; church — церковь; cinema — кинотеатр; theatre — театр; right — правый: turn to the right; traffic lights — светофор; block — квартал.
1-s115.answer: town, city, square, main, road, church, cinema, theatre, right, traffic lights, block

2-s115.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 2, с. 115. Посмотри на фотографии и скажи, что на них.
steps: 1. It is a museum. 2. It is a theatre. 3. It is a church. 4. It is a cinema. 5. It is a square.

3-s116.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 3, с. 116. Прочитай новые слова парами.
steps: rain — main; now — town; Kitty — city; coat — road; where — square.

4-s116.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 4, с. 116. Потренируйся произносить новые слова и прочитай примеры.
steps: My grandfather doesn't live in town. There are many big cities in England. Are there many squares in your town? This is the main street of the town. Go along the road. The church is opposite the cinema. Turn to the right at the traffic lights. Walk two blocks.
4-s116.answer: town, city, square, main, road, church, cinema, theatre, right, traffic lights, block

5-s116.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 5, с. 116. Скажи, где живёшь ты и твои друзья, используя фразы.
steps: I live in a big city, not far from the cinema. My friend lives in a small town near the main square. My friend lives in the country opposite the church.
5-s116.answer: I live in … not far from …; my friend lives near / opposite …

6-s117.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 6, с. 117. Прослушай диалог, прочитай и выучи наизусть.
steps: Andy: Excuse me, could you help me? Pete: Sure. Andy: Where is 42 Green Street, please? Pete: Walk to the corner and turn left. Andy: To the corner and then left? Pete: Right. Then walk two blocks to the traffic lights, and you're in Green Street. Andy: Thank you.
6-s117.answer: Excuse me, where is…? — Walk to the corner, turn left, walk two blocks to the traffic lights.

7-s117.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 7, с. 117. Придумай и разыграй диалог по образцу упр. 6.
steps: A: Excuse me, could you help me? B: Sure. A: Where is the theatre, please? B: Walk to the corner and turn right. A: To the corner and then right? B: That's right. Then walk three blocks to the traffic lights — the theatre is in Main Street. A: Thank you!
7-s117.answer: Where is the theatre? — Walk to the corner, turn right, three blocks to the traffic lights.

8-s117.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 8, с. 117. Прочитай диалог и скажи, что видели друзья Лены, пока искали её дом.
steps: Boris and his friend got lost. They saw the «Odeon» cinema, a big church and a museum — Lena's house is opposite the museum.
8-s117.answer: the Odeon cinema, a church, the museum

9-s118.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 9, с. 118. Прочитай диалог из упр. 8 в парах.
steps: Lena: Hello! Boris: Can I speak to Lena, please? Lena: Speaking. Boris: It's Boris Belov. We're lost! Lena: Where are you now? Boris: Near the Odeon. Lena: Oh, that's far from my house. Go along the road to the museum — my house is opposite it.

10-s118.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 10, с. 118. Ответь на вопросы по диалогу упр. 8.
steps: 1. Boris is calling Lena. 2. Because they are lost. 3. Near the Odeon. 4. Yes, it is far from Lena's house. 5. Boris isn't sure how they got there. 6. Yes, Lena's house is near the museum. 7. Yes, opposite the museum. 8. I think Lena lives in London.
10-s118.answer: Boris; lost; the Odeon; far; not sure; near the museum; opposite; London

11-s118.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 11, с. 118. По плану города найди самый быстрый путь от Королевского театра до дома Лены.
steps: Go along Green Street to the traffic lights, then turn left into Main Road. Go up Main Road, pass St John's Church on the left and St Mary's Hospital on the right. At High Street turn left, pass the hotel and stop at the City Museum. Lena's house is opposite the museum.
11-s118.answer: Green Street → Main Road → High Street → the museum; the house is opposite

12-s119.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 12, с. 119. Позвони другу, пригласи в гости и объясни, как добраться.
steps: — Hello, Ivan! Would you like to come to my place today? — Yes! How do I get there? — Go up Lomonosov Street, turn right into Aviatorov Street, go to the traffic lights, turn left, and my house is opposite the school.
12-s119.answer: Would you like to come? — Go up …, turn right …, my house is opposite …

13-s119.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 13, с. 119. Опиши город, в котором живёшь.
steps: I live in Moscow, the capital of Russia. It is the biggest city in the country. There are a lot of beautiful buildings, parks and squares. The most famous square is Red Square. There are many museums, theatres and cinemas. I like my city.
13-s119.answer: I live in … It is … There are … squares, museums, theatres.

14-s119.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 14, с. 119. Напиши 5–6 предложений о своём городе с новыми словами.
steps: I live in Moscow. It is the biggest city in Russia. There are a lot of buildings, parks and squares. The most famous square is Red Square. There are many museums, theatres and cinemas. You can visit old churches too. I love my city!
14-s119.answer: city, square, main, church, theatre, cinema

15-s119.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 15, с. 119. Выполни упр. 7 (с. 117) письменно.
steps: A: Excuse me, could you help me? B: Sure. A: Where is the theatre, please? B: Walk to the corner and turn right. Then walk three blocks to the traffic lights — the theatre is in Main Street. A: Thank you!
15-s119.answer: Записываем диалог о дороге к театру.

16-s119.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 16, с. 119. Расскажи, как пройти от дома к какому-либо месту.
steps: Go straight ahead along the street. Turn right at the traffic lights. Walk two blocks. Turn left. Cross the road — the shop is opposite the park.
16-s119.answer: go straight, turn right / left, walk two blocks, cross the road

17-s119.condition: Lesson 24, упр. 17, с. 119. Научись писать слова.
steps: church — церковь; cinema — кинотеатр; city — город; main — главный; right — правый; road — дорога; square — площадь; theatre — театр; town — городок; traffic lights — светофор; to turn to the left — повернуть налево; to walk two blocks — пройти два квартала.
17-s119.answer: church, cinema, city, main, right, road, square, theatre, town, traffic lights

1-s119.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 1, с. 119. Спроси друга, когда он был в этих местах.
steps: When did you go to the Pushkin Museum? When did you go to the Pobeda cinema? When did you go to the Bolshoi Theatre? When did you go to the main square? When did you go to the church near your house? When did you go to the Children's Theatre?

2-s120.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 2, с. 120. Представь себя учителем: спроси, когда и почему одноклассники это сделали.
steps: Why did you go to Moscow? — To see Red Square. When? — Last week. Why did you go to the Black Sea? — To swim. When? — A month ago. Why did you go to the cinema? — To see a new film. When? — Yesterday.
2-s120.answer: Why did you go…? — To … When? — last week / a month ago / yesterday

look-read-remember-s120.condition: Lesson 25, с. 120. Запомни слова и фразы, которые используются с Past Simple.
steps: yesterday — вчера; the day before yesterday — позавчера; yesterday morning / afternoon / evening; last week / month / year / Sunday; last night; a week / month / year ago; in 2010.
look-read-remember-s120.answer: yesterday, the day before yesterday, last…, …ago, in 2010

look-read-remember-s121.condition: Lesson 25, с. 121. Запомни формы глаголов и образование Present Perfect.
steps: Три формы: open — opened — opened; wash — washed — washed; visit — visited — visited (3-я форма — Participle II).
Present Perfect = have / has + Participle II: I have opened the window — now it is open. He has locked the door — now it is locked. You have decorated the hall — now it is beautiful.
look-read-remember-s121.answer: have / has + V3 — результат виден сейчас

3-s122.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 3, с. 122. По картинкам скажи, что сделали Кейт и Борис.
steps: Kate has watered the flowers. Kate and Boris have washed their faces. Kate and Boris have decorated the Christmas tree. Boris has cleaned the floor. Kate has cleaned the carpet. Boris has washed the dishes.
3-s122.answer: has watered, have washed, have decorated, has cleaned, has washed up

4-s122.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 4, с. 122. Попроси друга что-то сделать; друг отвечает, что уже сделал.
steps: Wash up! — I have washed up. Clean your teeth! — I have cleaned my teeth. Water the flowers! — I have watered the flowers. Visit your granny! — I have visited my granny. Lock the door! — I have locked the door. Clean the carpet! — I have cleaned the carpet.

look-read-remember-s122.condition: Lesson 25, с. 122. Запомни отрицательную форму Present Perfect.
steps: haven't / hasn't + V3: I haven't opened the window. He hasn't locked the door. She hasn't cooked dinner. We haven't cleaned the room. They haven't washed the floor.

5-s123.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 5, с. 123. По картинкам скажи, чего ребята не сделали.
steps: They haven't washed the dishes. She hasn't closed the window. He hasn't locked the door. They haven't watered the flowers.
5-s123.answer: haven't washed, hasn't closed, hasn't locked, haven't watered

6-s123.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 6, с. 123. По картинкам упр. 3 задай вопросы о Борисе и Кейт.
steps: Has Kate watered the flowers? — Yes, she has. Have they washed their faces? — Yes, they have. Have they decorated the Christmas tree? — Yes, they have. Has Boris cleaned the floor? — Yes, he has. Has Kate cleaned the carpet? — Yes, she has. Has Boris washed up? — Yes, he has.
6-s123.answer: Has / Have …? — Yes, she has / they have.

7-s123.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 7, с. 123. Прослушай диалог, прочитай и выучи наизусть.
steps: Alice: Hi, Polly! I haven't seen you for ages. How are you? Polly: Fine, and you? Alice: Just fine. Where are you going? Polly: To the cinema. Will you join me? Alice: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't — I must visit my granny today. Polly: OK, see you tomorrow!
7-s123.answer: I haven't seen you for ages. — Will you join me? — I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't.

look-read-remember-s123.condition: Lesson 25, с. 123. Запомни вопросы и ответы в Present Perfect.
steps: Have I opened the window? Has he / she locked it? Have you / we / they cleaned it? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. Yes, he has. / No, she hasn't. Yes, they have. / No, we haven't.
look-read-remember-s123.answer: Have / Has + подлежащее + V3? — Yes, … has / have.

8-s124.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 8, с. 124. Придумай свой диалог по образцу упр. 7.
steps: Anna: Hi, Maria! I haven't seen you for ages. How are you? Maria: Fine, and you? Anna: Just fine. Where are you going? Maria: To the park. Will you join me? Anna: I'd love to, but I'm afraid I can't — I'm going to the dentist today. Maria: OK, see you tomorrow!
8-s124.answer: Диалог по образцу: I haven't seen you for ages… Will you join me?

9-s124.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 9, с. 124. Прочитай текст и скажи, что Бетси знает о Лондоне.
steps: Betsy knows that London is the biggest city in Britain and one of the most important cities in the world. There are some of the best theatres, cinemas, museums, old churches and parks there, and a lot of streets and shops.
9-s124.answer: the biggest city in Britain; theatres, museums, churches, parks, shops

10-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 10, с. 125. Найди и прочитай предложения к картинкам.
steps: Oxford Street is London's main shopping centre. People from all over the world shop in Oxford Street. The largest park in London is Hyde Park.
10-s125.answer: Oxford Street — shopping centre; Hyde Park — the largest park

11-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 11, с. 125. Расскажи младшему брату или сестре о Лондоне.
steps: London is the biggest city in Britain. More than seven million people live there. It is one of the most important cities in the world. There are the best theatres, churches, parks, cinemas and museums. Oxford Street is the main shopping centre, and Hyde Park is the largest park.
11-s125.answer: the biggest city in Britain, 7 million people, theatres, museums, Oxford Street, Hyde Park

12-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 12, с. 125. Поговори с партнёром о Москве: почему одним нравится жить в большом городе, а другим нет.
steps: A: What do you think about Moscow? B: It's noisy — a lot of cars, the air is polluted, people are always busy. A: I disagree. There are many theatres, museums, parks and good schools. B: That's true, but I like quiet places.
12-s125.answer: noisy, cars, busy — theatres, museums, parks, schools

13-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 13, с. 125. Расскажи о городе, где ты живёшь.
steps: I live in Moscow, the capital of Russia. It is the biggest city in the country — more than 10 million people live there. There are many tourists because the city is beautiful: the Kremlin, Red Square, the Tretyakov Gallery. There are many theatres, parks and museums.
13-s125.answer: I live in … It is the capital … There are …

14-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 14, с. 125. Скажи, что ты не согласен с предложениями.
steps: No, you haven't watered the trees in your garden. Your little brother hasn't washed up. No, your granny hasn't cleaned the carpet. No, he hasn't locked his car. No, your friends haven't shopped in Oxford Street.

15-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 15, с. 125. Заполни пропуски в вопросах.
steps: 1. has he? 2. haven't they? 3. has she? 4. haven't we? 5. haven't they? 6. has she? 7. have they?
15-s125.answer: has he, haven't they, has she, haven't we, haven't they, has she, have they

16-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 16, с. 125. Вставь глаголы в предложения.
steps: 1. finished; 2. helped; 3. washed; 4. locked; 5. cleaned.

17-s125.condition: Lesson 25, упр. 17, с. 125. Не согласись с предложениями (Present Perfect, отрицание).
steps: Mother hasn't cooked supper. We haven't shopped a lot. The children haven't started to sing. Freddy hasn't danced a lot. They haven't decorated the New Year tree.
17-s125.answer: hasn't cooked, haven't shopped, haven't started, hasn't danced, haven't decorated

1-s126.condition: Lesson 26, упр. 1, с. 126. Составь как можно больше предложений с far from / not far from.
steps: The cinema is far from the main road. The church is far from the main road. My art school is not far from the traffic lights. The supermarket is not far from the traffic lights. The theatre is not far from the square.
1-s126.answer: … is far from / not far from the main road / traffic lights / square

2-s126.condition: Lesson 26, упр. 2, с. 126. Составь предложения со словами main, road, square, church, cinema; партнёр соглашается или нет.
steps: A: The cinema is far from the main road. B: That's not true, the cinema is near the main road. A: The church is not far from the centre. B: That's true. A: The theatre is in the main square. B: That's not true, it's in Green Street.

3-s126.condition: Lesson 26, упр. 3, с. 126. Игра: сделай вид, что выполнил действие.
steps: A: Decorate the room! B: I have decorated the room. C: He has decorated the room. A: Start helping your mum! B: I have started helping my mum. C: She has started helping her mum.

4-s126.condition: Lesson 26, упр. 4, с. 126. Научись произносить и использовать новые слова.

Then the Romans left Britain. London Bridge was the only bridge over the Thames until 1749, and there were houses and shops on it.
